description: On-chain flows into and out of exchange wallets over a window: inflow, outflow and net per exchange and asset (stablecoins, BTC, ETH). Net outflows often mean coins moving to self-custody, inflows coins ready to sell.

asset.description: Only this asset family, e.g. USDT, BTC.

name: get_exchange_flows

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.
